verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents that it aims to be Sentry API compatible, so tools built against Sentry's API should work with it. The GitLab and Grafana integrations, which connect through that Sentry-compatible interface, support the claim. However, there is no first-party API reference: OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and compatibility is stated only as an aim. The MCP server and CLI are separate surfaces and don't count toward this story. Missing for 10: a first-party documented API reference (endpoints, auth, tokens), a published OpenAPI spec, confirmation of how complete the Sentry API compatibility is, and independent or hands-on corroboration of programmatic API use.
